page.notes: The right margin carries only handwritten marks and a manuscript "16"; these are not printed and are left out. The page has a vertical crack or fold through the middle of the text, which breaks some words (for example "Iam si vellem", "Scripturas"); the lines were read across it. Some letters are blurred, but the text is legible throughout. Printed spelling such as "Epist.", "Colost.", "Homil." and "Iesuitæ" is kept as printed.
